formats.key: simpleBuy((address fromToken, address toToken, uint256 fromAmount, uint256 toAmount, uint256 expectedAmount, address[] callees, bytes exchangeData, uint256[] startIndexes, uint256[] values, address beneficiary, address partner, uint256 feePercent, bytes permit, uint256 deadline, bytes16 uuid) data)
effects: Takes up to fromAmount of fromToken from the signer through the TokenTransferProxy, or ETH as msg.value when fromToken is the 0xEeee sentinel.
Buys toAmount of toToken and sends it to beneficiary, or to the signer when beneficiary is zero.
Refunds the unspent fromToken to the signer, minus any partner or protocol fee that the router takes.
May run the signer's permit bytes on fromToken, which sets an allowance.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send (fromAmount of fromToken), Receive before fees (toAmount of toToken) and Beneficiary.

findings.title: simpleBuy labels the input ceiling 'Amount to Send' and the exact amount bought 'Receive before fees'; the intent says 'Swap'.
findings.evidence: descriptor simpleBuy: data.fromAmount uses $.display.definitions.sendAmount ('Amount to Send'), data.toAmount uses minReceiveAmount ('Receive before fees'), intent 'Swap'. In a buy, fromAmount is a maximum with a refund, and toAmount is the target output. Sibling buyOnUniswap uses maxSendAmount/receiveAmount and the intent 'Buy'.
findings.fix: Use maxSendAmount for data.fromAmount, receiveAmount for data.toAmount, and the intent 'Buy'.

findings.title: simpleBuy hides data.partner and data.feePercent, which set the fee taken in the trade.
findings.evidence: descriptor simpleBuy has no field for data.partner or data.feePercent. The fee logic sits in the router that the AugustusSwapper fallback delegatecalls to (selectorVsRouter).
findings.fix: Add data.feePercent and data.partner fields.

findings.title: simpleBuy beneficiary allows only EOA, and a zero beneficiary (meaning the sender) is shown as 0x0.
findings.evidence: definitions.beneficiary params.types ['eoa']. The router sends to msg.sender when beneficiary is address(0).
findings.fix: Allow types ['eoa','contract'] and add senderAddress: ['0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'] so the zero address shows as the signer.

findings.title: simpleBuy hides the permit bytes; they set an allowance on fromToken, which the swap needs anyway.
findings.evidence: data.permit has no field. The bytes are passed to the token's permit before the transferFrom.
findings.fix: None needed.

findings.title: simpleBuy is reached through a payable fallback, and no @.value field shows native value sent with token inputs.
findings.evidence: AugustusSwapper.sol fallback() external payable delegatecalls the router. sendAmount covers ETH only when fromToken is the sentinel.
findings.fix: Add an @.value field, or confirm that the router forces msg.value == 0 for token inputs.

formats.key: megaSwap((address fromToken, uint256 fromAmount, uint256 toAmount, uint256 expectedAmount, address beneficiary, (uint256 fromAmountPercent, (address to, uint256 totalNetworkFee, (address adapter, uint256 percent, uint256 networkFee, (uint256 index, address targetExchange, uint256 percent, bytes payload, uint256 networkFee)[] route)[] adapters)[] path)[] path, address partner, uint256 feePercent, bytes permit, uint256 deadline, bytes16 uuid) data)
effects: Takes fromAmount of fromToken from the signer, or ETH as msg.value when fromToken is the sentinel.
Swaps across the mega paths and sends the final token (path[0].path[last].to) to beneficiary, or to the signer when zero, checked against toAmount.
A partner or protocol fee (feePercent, partner, a share of positive slippage above expectedAmount) is cut from the output.
May run the signer's permit on fromToken.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send (fromAmount of fromToken), Receive before fees (toAmount of the last token of path[0]) and Beneficiary.

findings.title: megaSwap hides feePercent and partner; the fee cuts the output below the 'before fees' minimum by an amount not shown.
findings.evidence: descriptor megaSwap: no field for data.feePercent or data.partner. The minReceiveAmount label 'Receive before fees' admits a fee but not its size.
findings.fix: Add data.feePercent and data.partner fields.

findings.title: megaSwap beneficiary allows only EOA, and zero (meaning the sender) is shown literally.
findings.evidence: definitions.beneficiary types ['eoa'].
findings.fix: Allow contract types and map the zero address to the sender.

findings.title: megaSwap hides the permit bytes, which set an allowance the swap needs.
findings.evidence: data.permit has no field.
findings.fix: None needed.

findings.title: megaSwap runs through a payable fallback, and no @.value field shows ETH sent with a token input.
findings.evidence: AugustusSwapper.sol fallback() external payable.
findings.fix: Add an @.value field, or confirm that the router rejects value for token inputs.

formats.key: swapOnUniswap(uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address[] path)
effects: Takes amountIn of path[0] from the signer, or ETH as msg.value when path[0] is the sentinel.
Swaps through the Uniswap V2 pairs and sends at least amountOutMin of path[last] to the signer.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send (amountIn of path[0]) and Receive before fees (amountOutMin of path[-1]).

findings.title: swapOnUniswap labels amountOutMin 'Receive before fees', though this path takes no partner fee.
findings.evidence: descriptor swapOnUniswap: amountOutMin uses minReceiveAmount ('Receive before fees'). The function has no partner or feePercent input.
findings.fix: Use a 'Minimum to Receive' label.

findings.title: swapOnUniswap runs through a payable fallback, and no @.value field shows ETH sent with a token input.
findings.evidence: AugustusSwapper.sol fallback() external payable delegatecalls the router.

formats.key: swapOnUniswapV2Fork(address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address weth, uint256[] pools)
effects: Takes amountIn of tokenIn from the signer, or ETH as msg.value when tokenIn is the sentinel; the ETH is wrapped through weth.
Swaps through the packed pools and sends at least amountOutMin of the last pool's output token to the signer, unwrapped to ETH when weth is set and the output is WETH.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send (amountIn of tokenIn), a raw 'Minimum to Receive' and the last pool word shown as an address.

findings.title: swapOnUniswapV2Fork shows the minimum received as a raw integer with no token or decimals.
findings.evidence: descriptor swapOnUniswapV2Fork: {path: 'amountOutMin', label: 'Minimum to Receive', format: 'raw'}.
findings.fix: There is no tokenPath, because the output token comes from the pool direction bit. Keep the label and add the weth field as a hint.

findings.title: swapOnUniswapV2Fork formats a packed uint256 pool word as an address name.
findings.evidence: field pools.[-1] uses lastPool (format addressName) on a uint256 that packs the pair address with direction and fee bits.
findings.fix: Drop the field, or slice the low 20 bytes when the runners support it.

findings.title: swapOnUniswapV2Fork cannot show the output token, or whether it arrives as ETH or WETH.
findings.evidence: The output token is read from the pair and the direction bit in pools[-1]. The weth parameter has no field.
findings.fix: Show weth as a field. Otherwise this waits on the spec.
